schema: CREATE TABLE "booths" ("booth_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "is_open" INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT b1.booth_id FROM booths AS b1 WHERE b1.is_open = 1 AND ((SELECT is_open FROM booths AS b2 WHERE b2.booth_id = b1.booth_id - 1) = 1 OR (SELECT is_open FROM booths AS b2 WHERE b2.booth_id = b1.booth_id + 1) = 1)

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces correlated neighbor equality checks (is_open = 1) with a self-join sum predicate a.is_open + b.is_open = 2, admitting non-unit summands such as (2, 0).
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.booth_id FROM booths AS a CROSS JOIN booths AS b WHERE ABS(a.booth_id - b.booth_id) = 1 AND a.is_open + b.is_open = 2 ORDER BY a.booth_id ASC
